Build the remaining "Marketing hub" pieces for Nxeon's admin portal (Next.js + Prisma + Postgres at /opt/nxeon): a creative Studio, a Posting/Calendar queue, and an Assets library — under the EXISTING "Marketing" admin nav section (which already has: Marketing entry [Overview/Discovery/Reviews] + Cold Email entry). Add a new entry (or tabs) for Studio / Calendar / Assets.

Branch `feature/marketing-hub` off main (main is at 1a6b65f). Commit + `git push -u origin feature/marketing-hub`. Do NOT commit to main, do NOT deploy, do NOT `prisma db push`, do NOT edit .env. `npx prisma generate` + `npm run build` MUST pass 0 errors; add tests where sensible.

STUDY FIRST: lib/admin-groups.ts (the "Marketing" section you'll extend), lib/rbac.ts (map new routes → area "platform"), components/ui/primitives.tsx, an existing admin client component (e.g. components/admin/coldemail/Controls.tsx) for the "use client" + server-actions pattern, lib/anthropic.ts (askClaude, for AI caption/copy generation — degrade gracefully if no key). The Nxeon brand: navy #0B1224, panels #141E3A/#182647, violet #7C5CFF, cyan #22D3EE, green #34D399, ink #EAF0FF, violet→cyan gradient bar.

=== HARD GUARDRAILS ===
- NO real posting to Instagram/Meta/Reddit/X and NO sending — channel connectors are STUBS (there's no ad/social API access yet). "Posting" is draft + schedule + manual "mark posted" bookkeeping + export only.
- Studio rasterization must be DEPLOY-SAFE: render creatives as inline SVG in-browser and rasterize to PNG CLIENT-SIDE via canvas (no server-side native image libraries, no new native deps). Store the SVG/spec in the DB; the browser produces the PNG on download.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1) Prisma (additive): MarketingAsset (kind enum POST/STORY/BANNER/VIDEO_FRAME, title, format/width/height, templateKey, paramsJson, svg text, createdAt), MarketingPost (channel enum INSTAGRAM/FACEBOOK/REDDIT/X/BLOG, caption, assetId?, scheduledFor?, status enum DRAFT/SCHEDULED/POSTED/CANCELLED default DRAFT, postedAt?, externalUrl?, createdAt/updatedAt), MarketingChannel (kind, handle, connected bool default false, note). Indexes.
2) lib/marketing/templates.ts (shared, pure) — a set of on-brand creative templates (IG post 1080², story 1080×1920, banner 1200×628, video frame 1920×1080) with a renderTemplate(templateKey, values) => SVG string using the Nxeon palette above. Port the visual style from the existing brand ad creatives (bold headline, offer pill, logo lockup, gradient bar). Editable fields per template (headline, subhead, offer, coupon, cta, domain).
3) Studio UI /admin/marketing/studio (client): pick template → fill fields → LIVE inline SVG preview → "Save to Assets" (server action stores svg+params as MarketingAsset) → "Download PNG" (client-side canvas rasterize of the SVG). Optional "AI caption" via askClaude.
4) Assets library /admin/marketing/assets: gallery of saved MarketingAsset with inline SVG preview + client-side PNG download + delete.
5) Calendar/Posting /admin/marketing/calendar: compose a MarketingPost (caption + pick a saved asset + channel + optional schedule), list by status/date, actions Schedule / Mark posted (+external URL) / Cancel. A Channels sub-view listing MarketingChannel with "Connect" STUB buttons (mark connected=false with a "requires API access" note; no network). A dry-run/export (copy caption + download asset) so posts are ready to post manually.
6) Wire these into the "Marketing" nav section in lib/admin-groups.ts (new entry "Studio" with tabs Studio/Assets/Calendar, or add tabs to the Marketing entry — your call, keep it clean), hrefs → area "platform" in rbac.ts, each page requireArea("platform"). Server actions in lib/actions-marketing-studio.ts (each re-checks the area). Update docs/DOCUMENTATION.md.

When done: prisma generate + npm run build clean; commit + push; report files added/changed, models added, build/test result, and the staging command `cd /opt/nxeon && bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh feature/marketing-hub`. Do not deploy.

## Marketing Hub — Studio / Assets / Calendar (2026-08-10)

The remaining Marketing hub pieces: a creative **Studio**, an **Assets** library and a posting
**Calendar**. Added as a new entry **"Studio"** (icon `content`) in the existing **Marketing** nav
section (`lib/admin-groups.ts`), with tabs Studio / Assets / Calendar. All three routes map to area
`platform` (ADMIN-only) via `HREF_AREA` in `lib/rbac.ts`, and each page calls `requireArea("platform")`.
Built on branch `feature/marketing-hub`.

**Hard guardrails honoured.** Nothing here posts to Instagram/Meta/Reddit/X or sends anything — channel
connectors are **stubs** (no ad/social API access yet). "Posting" is draft + schedule + a manual "mark
posted" flag (with the operator-pasted external URL) + export only. Studio rasterization is deploy-safe:
creatives render as **inline SVG in the browser** and rasterize to PNG **client-side via `<canvas>`** — no
server-side native image library, no new native deps. The SVG/spec is stored in the DB; the browser
produces the PNG on download.

**Models (additive, `prisma/schema.prisma`).**

- `MarketingAsset` — a saved creative: `kind` (enum `POST` / `STORY` / `BANNER` / `VIDEO_FRAME`), `title`,
  `format`, `width`/`height`, `templateKey`, `paramsJson` (the editable field values), `svg` (the full
  self-contained SVG text), `createdAt`. Indexed on `kind`, `createdAt`.
- `MarketingPost` — a planned post: `channel` (enum `MarketingChannelKind`), `caption`, `assetId?`
  (`onDelete: SetNull`), `scheduledFor?`, `status` (enum `DRAFT` / `SCHEDULED` / `POSTED` / `CANCELLED`,
  default `DRAFT`), `postedAt?`, `externalUrl?`, timestamps. Indexed on `channel`, `status`,
  `scheduledFor`, `createdAt`.
- `MarketingChannel` — a connector row: `kind`, `handle`, `connected` (bool, default **false**), `note`,
  timestamps. `@@unique([kind])`. `connected` never becomes true (no real API).
- Enums: `MarketingAssetKind`, `MarketingChannelKind` (`INSTAGRAM` / `FACEBOOK` / `REDDIT` / `X` / `BLOG`,
  reused by both post channel and connector), `MarketingPostStatus`.

**Templates (`lib/marketing/templates.ts`)** — PURE, shared, no imports/side effects (consumed by both the
Studio client for live preview + rasterization and the server action that persists the SVG). `renderTemplate(key, values)`
returns a complete self-contained SVG string using the Nxeon palette (navy `#0B1224`, panels `#141E3A`/`#182647`,
violet `#7C5CFF`, cyan `#22D3EE`, green `#34D399`, ink `#EAF0FF`, violet→cyan gradient bar). Four templates:
IG post 1080², story 1080×1920, banner 1200×628, video frame 1920×1080. Editable fields: headline, subhead,
offer, coupon, cta, domain. All field values are XML-escaped (`escapeXml`) so a headline can never break out of
its `<text>`.

**Surface.**

- `/admin/marketing/studio` — pick a template → fill fields → **live inline SVG preview** → **Save to
  Assets** (server action re-renders the SVG server-side; the client-supplied SVG is never trusted) →
  **Download PNG** (client-side canvas rasterize) → optional **AI caption** via `askClaude` (BYOK/effective
  key; degrades to a friendly hint when no key is configured).
- `/admin/marketing/assets` — gallery of saved `MarketingAsset` with inline preview + client-side PNG
  download + delete + "Use in post" deep-link.
- `/admin/marketing/calendar` — compose a `MarketingPost` (caption + optional saved asset + channel +
  optional schedule); list by schedule/date with per-row **Schedule** / **Mark posted (+ external URL)** /
  **Cancel** / **Delete**; an **Export** action (copy caption + client-side PNG download) so a post is ready
  to publish manually; and a **Channels** panel listing every `MarketingChannelKind` with **Connect** stub

`components/admin/marketing/CalendarClient.tsx` (composer, post rows, channel stubs).
